llm.summary: This is a teacher-facing Chinese chemistry lesson-planning skill with scoped class-data use and no hidden executable behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill uses a class teaching workspace and reads class profile, weaknesses, tiers, interaction logs, and review plans to draft lesson plans; this is proportionate for teacher planning and the schema is explicitly narrowed to those fields.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown and JSON reference/schema files only; no executable scripts, install hooks, remote payload retrieval, or package-install instructions were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to chemistry lesson design, require teacher review of drafts, limit experiment content to placement and safety level, and include crisis-handling and privacy boundaries.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: It declares platform memory and file capabilities, but writes only pending lesson-plan entries for teacher confirmation and provides view, correct, delete, pause-memory, sharing-control, and export controls.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is chemistry lesson planning around macro-micro-symbolic representation, unit compression, and junior-to-senior transition; the artifacts consistently support that purpose and redirect lab operations, exams, notation drills, and non-chemistry work elsewhere.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Installers should treat this as a Mainland China, Simplified Chinese K12 chemistry-teacher tool. Before using it elsewhere, localize curriculum assumptions and crisis/help contacts. Teachers should review all generated lesson plans, especially experiment placements and safety levels, before classroom use.
llm.findings: [SQP-3] expected: The Mainland China Chinese K12 default is real, but it is explicitly disclosed as the intended regional scope and the shared crisis/localization files warn deployers not to use Mainland China help channels outside that region without localization; this is a deployment-context note rather than hidden or purpose-mismatched behavior.
